title: Protocol URL command evidence can retain an opaque path segment
title_de: Protocol-URL-Command-Evidence kann einen undurchsichtigen Pfadabschnitt behalten
summary: The public protocol-client target can persist a PROTOCOL_URL path segment in client-command.txt after only userinfo and query redaction; a full-lifecycle path can copy that artifact into canonical evidence.
summary_de: Das öffentliche protocol-client-Target kann nach Redaction nur von Userinfo und Query einen PROTOCOL_URL-Pfadabschnitt in client-command.txt persistieren; ein Full-Lifecycle-Pfad kann dieses Artefakt in kanonische Evidence kopieren.
observed_behavior: _safe_url_for_command retains parsed.path, _redacted_command renders it, and _write_artifacts writes client-command.txt. The full-lifecycle copier accepts that required artifact without a path-redaction pass. Existing unit coverage proves query redaction only.
observed_behavior_de: _safe_url_for_command behält parsed.path, _redacted_command rendert ihn und _write_artifacts schreibt client-command.txt. Der Full-Lifecycle-Copier akzeptiert dieses erforderliche Artefakt ohne Pfad-Redaction. Bestehende Unit-Coverage beweist nur Query-Redaction.
expected_behavior: Evidence command artifacts must not retain opaque URL path secrets or sensitive direct CLI resolution mappings; a useful non-sensitive endpoint representation may remain only when its safety is explicit.
expected_behavior_de: Evidence-Command-Artefakte dürfen keine undurchsichtigen URL-Pfadsecrets oder sensiblen direkten CLI-Resolution-Mappings behalten; eine nützliche nicht-sensitive Endpoint-Repräsentation darf nur bei expliziter Sicherheit verbleiben.
impact: A caller who embeds a token or personal value in a documented protocol URL path could cause it to be retained and copied into evidence. Actual production path sensitivity and evidence-reader access were not established.
impact_de: Ein Aufrufer, der ein Token oder einen Personenwert in einen dokumentierten Protocol-URL-Pfad einbettet, könnte dessen Retention und Kopie in Evidence auslösen. Tatsächliche produktive Pfadsensitivität und Evidence-Lesezugriff wurden nicht belegt.
preconditions: A caller supplies a sensitive opaque path segment through the documented PROTOCOL_URL interface or direct CLI URL option.
The protocol client writes its managed artifact bundle.
For canonical retention, the full-lifecycle artifact-copy path is selected.
reproduction: Inspect copy_protocol_client_artifacts() in ci/checks/catalog/no_crs_baseline.py and the query-only unit coverage in tests/protocol_client/test_protocol_client.py.
Do not generate a live artifact containing a secret until a safe synthetic validation plan is approved.

evidence.command: rtk sed -n '589,631p;1186,1201p;1472,1475p' ci/checks/protocol/protocol_client.py; rtk sed -n '3956,3998p' ci/checks/catalog/no_crs_baseline.py
python3 -m unittest tests.protocol_client.test_protocol_client tests.protocol_client.test_check_protocol_evidence -v; Framework PR #50 SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate/API issues readback

root_cause: Command-artifact redaction treats query strings and userinfo as sensitive but preserves every path segment, and neither the artifact copier nor validator provides a second path or --resolve redaction control.
root_cause_de: Die Command-Artefakt-Redaction behandelt Query-Strings und Userinfo als sensibel, behält aber jeden Pfadabschnitt; weder Artefakt-Copier noch Validator bieten eine zweite Pfad- oder --resolve-Redaction-Kontrolle.
proposed_remediation: After focused validation, reduce artifact URLs to a safe authority plus an explicit redacted path marker, redact direct --resolve values, add synthetic path/percent-encoded/IPv6 coverage, and preserve harmless endpoint diagnostics where justified.
proposed_remediation_de: Nach fokussierter Validierung Artefakt-URLs auf sichere Authority plus expliziten redigierten Pfadmarker reduzieren, direkte --resolve-Werte redigieren, synthetische Pfad-/Percent-Encoding-/IPv6-Coverage ergänzen und harmlose Endpoint-Diagnostik bei Begründung erhalten.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic secret-like path values do not appear in client-command.txt or copied canonical evidence.
Direct CLI --resolve values are redacted or demonstrably excluded from retained command artifacts.
Query, userinfo, harmless health path, IPv6, and protocol-client legitimate controls pass.
No current user-approved security remediation scope has been exceeded.
validation_plan: Use codex-security validation before a fix to establish the supported boundary, synthetic artifact persistence, and reader exposure assumptions.
If confirmed and separately authorized, use codex-security fix-finding with focused protocol-client unit and artifact-copy regression tests.
Run the protocol-contract workflow/current exact PR head after a future remediation.
regression_tests: tests/protocol_client/test_protocol_client.py with synthetic opaque path, percent-encoded path, IPv6, and --resolve cases.
A full-lifecycle artifact-copy control proving the copied command artifact remains redacted.
legitimate_control_tests: A harmless /health protocol URL remains diagnostically useful without a sensitive path value.
Existing query and userinfo redaction remains intact.
residual_risk: The resulting-master regression suite verifies redaction of opaque paths and --resolve values while retaining harmless health, query, userinfo, IPv6, and protocol-client controls. No risk acceptance was used.
residual_risk_de: Die Resulting-Master-Regression prüft die Redaction undurchsichtiger Pfade und --resolve-Werte bei Erhalt harmloser Health-, Query-, Userinfo-, IPv6- und Protocol-Client-Kontrollen. Es wurde keine Risikoakzeptanz verwendet.

history.detail: Static source-to-sink evidence found a public protocol URL path-retention candidate. No live secret artifact, exploit, or remediation was performed; the item is separate from common-structure and Sonar remediation.
Framework PR #50 implemented bounded command-artifact path, query, and --resolve redaction with an independent evidence validator and focused regression coverage.
Exact Framework master de705a5efb872f95f010346fe2e6143c88876ad4 passed all 28 focused protocol/evidence tests; PR #50 SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate was OK with zero unresolved issues.
